claim: One visually frozen development candidate; zero complete computed cycles and zero scores.
fixture_scope: Target 10 original records, all 33 original source events and 10 samples exported from full 249-frame preparation. Not a standalone full-media substitute.

reviewers.observation: Frames 29–32 near feet together and relatively still; around 33 to 35/36 anatomical left foot moves toward screen right; 36–38 relatively still.
Frames 29–31 near feet together; frame 32 already suggests displacement; 33–35 expansion is clear; 36–38 relatively stable.

visual_observation.disagreement: Independent onset bracket may be one frame earlier; keep both descriptions and the fixed 29–38 original window. No numerical results used to reconcile them.

step_motion_observation.source_description: Two nonexpert visual reviews of unmodified original frames 29–38 observe the anatomical left foot (screen right) move outward. Candidate only; no front-foot, target-direction, contact or force truth. Preserve the 31–33 versus around-33 movement-onset disagreement.

execution_attempts.io_failure: Default pose preset asset absent in archive; no inference attempted.
In-memory tuples compared directly to JSON lists; final replay compares JSON representation.

allowed_changes_only: source_geometry_series rows add normalization_basis, pose_source, source_binding
